pictures.name: FT1-Nazareth-Morning
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Early morning in a small first-century stone village in the hills of Galilee: flat-roofed limestone houses, an olive tree, a well. In the middle, a young woman of about sixteen with olive skin, dark hair under a simple deep blue headscarf, a plain undyed wool dress, a calm, thoughtful face, carries a clay water jar on her hip along a dusty lane, glancing up at the soft sky. A dove on a rooftop. Pale gold sunrise light, deep blue shadows between the houses. Ordinary, peaceful, quietly expectant. No text, no letters, no logos.
